title: The inspector is down: fail closed blocks, fail open lets it through
goal: {{castBrand}} has to decide what {{castApp}} does while it is {{castTask}} and the inspector cannot be reached.
obstacle: An unreachable inspector means nothing is being checked. Blocking everything is safe but stops the work; letting calls through keeps working but unchecked.
control: With fail closed even a harmless prompt is blocked with a named error. With fail open the call goes through and the gateway log says it failed open. Whether the product offers both is not known.
